title: Make lockfile reproducibility independent of pip internal API drift
rawUserRequest: Continue the authorized remediation plan to completion. Correct workflow failures through governed Work Items, not temporary bypasses; use the temporary self-hosted runner only as outage-time feedback and retain official hosted gates for merge and release.

declaredIntent.summary: Make the committed development lockfile reproducibility check independent of pip-tools use of removed pip private APIs while preserving exact lockfile comparison and hosted enforcement.

outOfScope: Bypassing, disabling, or downgrading lockfile reproducibility checks.
Merging, closing, rebasing, or otherwise mutating unrelated PRs, including #723 and #726.
Publishing a release or treating the temporary self-hosted runner as an official hosted gate.

riskAssessment.reason: The check protects supply-chain reproducibility and is invoked by both ordinary hosted verification and release preflight; the correction must remain deterministic across supported pip versions.

acceptance: `make check-lockfile-reproducibility` remains fail-closed and compares normalized regenerated content to the committed lockfile, but does not rely on pip-tools importing a removed private pip API.
Compatibility and release workflows install a deterministic compiler/runtime combination before invoking the same lockfile target; no workflow skips, masks, or downgrades the gate.
Regression tests cover the public Make command and both hosted bootstrap paths, including the pinned compatibility boundary that prevents the reported ImportError.
Canonical workflow documentation and generated capability/documentation-alignment evidence explain the enforced reproducibility boundary and are refreshed.
guidelines: Use stable, declared tool dependencies; do not rely on private pip internals or ambient runner package versions.
Preserve exact lockfile reproduction and failure semantics; a compatibility fix must not weaken the security or release gate.
Keep ordinary hosted and release workflow setup aligned and covered by focused regression tests.
Document public command behavior and tool-version constraints in canonical workflow guidance.

intent.problem: Hosted lockfile verification failed before regeneration because the installed pip-tools imports `stdlib_pkgs` from pip private internals, which the runner pip version no longer provides.
constraints: Preserve the lockfile comparison and fail-closed behavior.
Use one deterministic compatibility strategy in both compatibility and release workflows.
Do not use the temporary self-hosted runner to satisfy official hosted evidence or bypass a failing check.
Do not alter unrelated dependency proposals, releases, or PR state.
intent.rationale: Pinning or otherwise constraining the compiler's supported runtime dependency boundary makes the reproducibility proof deterministic instead of depending on mutable GitHub runner pip internals.
